rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides tools for discrete mathematics education and computation. Includes Boolean logic operations, truth table generation, prime testing, factorization, GCD/LCM calculation, modular arithmetic, and Euler's totient function. Features algorithm visualizers for sorting (bubble, quick, merge) and graph traversal (BFS, DFS, Dijkstra). Also offers cryptography tools including Caesar cipher, Vigenere cipher, RSA, and AES-256 encryption.
